a1.say: Let's solve Where Would It Go?, using the Binary Search (lower bound) approach.

a1.cap: nums is sorted with distinct values. Return the index of target if present; otherwise return the index where it would be inserted to keep the order. Use O(log n).

a1.cap: We want the first position whose value is at least the target. Use a half-open range [LO, HI): if the middle value is smaller than the target, the answer is to the right; otherwise the middle might be the answer, so keep it.
a1.say: We want the first position whose value is at least the target. Use a half-open range LO, HI): if the middle value is smaller than the target, the answer is to the right; otherwise the middle might be the answer, so keep it.

a1.cap: When LO meets HI, that's the insert position.

LO and HI met at index 2.
